Features

// product

Everything you need to debug in production

One pipeline for logs, metrics and traces — with the query speed and alerting your on-call rotation actually deserves.

(01) Capability 06 MODULES
capability // 06 modules
01

Unified telemetry

Logs, metrics and traces share one schema and one timeline.

02

Sub-second queries

A columnar engine scans billions of events in milliseconds.

03

Smart alerting

Anomaly detection that learns your baselines and pages only when it matters.

04

Distributed tracing

Follow a request from edge to database with full span context.

05

Tiered retention

Hot for 30 days, warm for a year. Pay for what you query.

06

SOC 2 & SSO

SAML, SCIM, audit logs and field-level redaction from day one.
